summary: Planban 1.1.1 improves Windows watcher reliability, makes long Group names readable, keeps first-run onboarding off established boards, and ensures agent-made planning changes finish with one verified Board handoff.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Verify the plugin and MCP tools, open an established project board from a fresh browser origin and confirm the first-run tour tile does not cover it, confirm the explicit tutorial and demo onboarding still work, verify board updates remain live, check that a long Group name scrolls on hover or keyboard focus while reduced-motion mode keeps the ellipsis, and confirm a successful Planban mutation returns one verified clickable Board URL without repeated browser opens.
changelogSummary: More reliable Windows board updates, readable long Group names, correctly scoped first-run onboarding, and a clearer return to the changed Board after agent planning work.
